messages:
Rhea (marketing): quick one for the launch copy team: we want to assert a warmed-session p95 for hero-x is under 320ms. can runtime run a small validation pack that includes a cold baseline, a warmed session cohort, and one aggressive burst scenario? need artifacts + a one-sentence pass/fail for the writers by EOD tomorrow.

Noah (eng-runtime): yep. define warmed for your claim. prime size, followups, and what variants to include?

Rhea (marketing): warmed = 1.5k token prime then 6 sequential requests in the same session. include fp16 and our recommended int8 variant. acceptance if warmed p95 <= 320ms and warmed p95 no more than 1.4x cold p95. for the burst scenario simulate 60 rps for 45s on warmed int8 and ensure <2% of requests exceed 600ms.

Cam (product): can we also get 5 raw outputs per cell for a quick quality spot-check? product will scan for obvious degradation.

Noah (eng-runtime): plan: - cold cohort: 800 independent requests seq=1536 - warmed cohort: 400 traces prime=1536 + 6 followups - burst: warmed int8 burst_rps=60 dur=45s - variants: fp16, int8-llm - hardware: 2 x A100 40GB - outputs: CSV (model,variant,cohort,sample_id,latency_ms,status,seed), 5 jsonl samples/cell, percentile summary. estimate ~90-120m.

Noah (eng-runtime): sample CLI well use:```bash
# cold
curl -s -X POST https://bench.internal/run -d '{"model":"hero-x","variant":"fp16","requests":800,"seq":1536}'
# warmed
curl -s -X POST https://bench.internal/run -d '{"model":"hero-x","variant":"int8-llm","prime":1536,"followups":6,"requests":400,"traces":true}'
# burst
curl -s -X POST https://bench.internal/run -d '{"model":"hero-x","variant":"int8-llm","prime":1536,"followups":6,"burst_rps":60,"burst_dur_s":45}'
```

Rhea (marketing): perfect. small note: marketing will only put warmed p95 in the headline if acceptance passes; otherwise we'll cite conservative cold medians. also please redact any internal URIs in samples.

Noah (eng-runtime): understood. question: warm weights between variant runs or restart? warming yields production-like numbers; restart gives worst-case.

Rhea (marketing): warm weights between variants is fine, but keep cold cohort strictly no-cache. include details in the runbook so we can be explicit in the blog footnote.

bench-bot: bench-job-2155555555 scheduled by Noah at 2025-11-21T18:02:00Z

Noah (eng-runtime): launching now. will post artifacts (CSV + jsonl samples + summary) to this thread and a one-line PASS/FAIL against the acceptance criteria.

Cam (product): thanks folks 44d will review samples as soon as they land.
